How to play

A flag appears; type the country it belongs to. The list suggests names as you type, or switch to multiple choice, or put a whole continent on screen at once with the grid layout. Missed flags come back at the end of the round, and My stats shows which flags you're slowest on.

Which flags are included?

All 197 countries: the 193 UN members plus Vatican City, Palestine, Kosovo and Taiwan, grouped by continent. Turn on speed run to race the clock and set a record for each continent.
